copy.tagline: 在 SunPerp 上自动执行永续合约交易
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 TRON 链上自动化交易 USDT 本位永续合约
copy.tagline_en: Automate perpetual futures trading on SunPerp
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate USDT-margined perpetual futures trading on TRON

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你查询 SunPerp 永续合约市场数据、下单、管理仓位和账户。它会调用 REST API 执行你的交易指令。
howto.when: 当你提出与 SunPerp 永续合约交易相关的请求时触发，比如查询行情、开仓、平仓、设置杠杆等。

say.text: 在 BTC-USDT 上以市价买入 5 张合约。
say.note: Claude 会确认余额和价格后执行。

say.text: 把 ETH-USDT 杠杆设为 20 倍，再挂限价买入 10 张。
say.note: Claude 会先设杠杆再下单。

say.text: 关闭我的 BTC-USDT 仓位。
say.note: Claude 会平仓并报告盈亏。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can query market data, place orders, manage positions, and manage your account on SunPerp perpetual futures via REST API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request SunPerp perpetual futures trading actions such as checking prices, opening/closing positions, or setting leverage.

say_en.text: Buy 5 contracts of BTC-USDT at market price.
say_en.note: Claude confirms balance and price before executing.

say_en.text: Set leverage to 20x on ETH-USDT and place a limit buy for 10 contracts.
say_en.note: Claude sets leverage then places the order.
Claude closes the position and reports PnL.
